verdict.rationale: Snowflake Semantic Views are a first-class, schema-level object letting analysts define business metrics, entities, and relationships once inside the database (snowflake-docs-11/23/47), and Cortex Analyst lets business users and AI query against that same semantic layer in natural language without writing SQL (snowflake-docs-13/25), giving one governed model consistently answered by both SQL and AI tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of consistency across multiple consuming tools, and detail on join/versioning governance controls beyond the docs snippets.
